flags.4: lifetime tracking complete from first artifact

scope.libraries: IR artifact-owned references, not every underlying driver object; releasing an owner does not prove physical reclaim
scope.metallibBytes: serialized compiler output bytes, not Metal-private library allocation
scope.diskRestore: successful file validation plus Metal library/function/reflection reconstruction; file hits separately include rejected Metal data
scope.deviceAllocated: MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize, overlaps application resources; do not sum with Vulkan requested bytes
scope.snapshots: approximate concurrent atomic/locked reads; idle snapshots can validate owned-reference balance
scope.diskLibraryCreate: newLibraryWithData attempts from disk hits only; includes failed Metal library creation, excludes dispatch-data setup, function lookup, file read, reflection and new compiler output; nanoseconds, opt-in

sampling: app emits low-frequency MELONX_IR_MEMORY_STATS; native API itself is read-only
lifetime: device cumulative counters; zero live values after release are valid, missing API/coverage must remain explicit
compatibility: Version-1 prefix fields 0-36 unchanged; capacity 37-39 returns 37, capacity >=40 returns 40. Timing-tail presence indicates support, not observation: timing is available only when flags 2 and 4 are both set. Missing, disabled or partial timing is unavailable, not zero.
